text:
luke (All-hands host): thanks everyone for coming — quick follow-up thread re: customer wins/losses from today's Q&A. can folks post 1) the top reason we won or lost a deal recently and 2) one concrete action we should take in the next 2 weeks? keep it short.

maya (VP Sales): win — our latency guarantees + clear benchmarks helped close a fintech pilot. loss — we lost a healthcare PoC due to data residency + no on-prem quickstart. action: produce a 1-pager on Private deployment timelines and an on-prem quickstart checklist. :page_facing_up:

alice (Customer Success): win — onboarding walkthrough and templated prompts reduced time-to-first-value for one ecomm customer. loss — customers complain about noisy default prompts (inconsistent outputs). action: create a small prompt-catalog with 5 vetted prompts per vertical and ship to CS templates.

jorge (Product): win insight aligns with what we saw — customers value predictable latency and token cost. loss pattern: feature gaps around enterprise auth (IdP provisioning). action: prioritize an IdP integration spike and publish a compatibility matrix.

ravi (Eng): engineering note on losses: some model variants we surface still fail memory/kv-cache limits at seqlen 8k under heavy batching. action: short-term mitigation: add a guardrail in routing to fallback to a lower-seqlen-optimized variant + telemetry. longer: kernel fixes in next runtime sprint.

tanya (Solutions): real example: lost retail account because labeling the behaviour of hallucination cases was manual and slow. action: assemble a 1-week eval prompt suite + a template for hallucination test cases so SEs can show measured reduction.

elena (RevOps): request — can folks drop examples of the lost deals (anonymized) into the shared folder? we need exact loss reasons for ops analysis. also can we standardize the "why-lost" tag in Salesforce so the data's usable.

sam (CEO): thanks — high level: focus on three things this month: 1) Private/on-prem onboarding materials (Maya + Eng + Product) 2) Enterprise auth/IdP compatibility (Jorge + Eng) 3) Prompt/catalog + evals for top verticals (CS + Solutions). i'm ok shipping pragmatic docs and clear mitigations rather than perfect product changes. :rocket:

luke (All-hands host): great, i'll create a checklist with owners and drop a collaborative doc. please add short bullet examples (1-2 lines) per lost/won deal. i'll follow up in two weeks with progress. :thumbsup:

maya (VP Sales): adding those examples now. tagging folks: @alice @tanya — will share anonymized feedback by EOD.

alice (Customer Success): done — uploaded 3 anonymized case notes to the folder and linked in the doc.

jorge (Product): will carve out Monday for the IdP spike and post progress in #product-sync.

ravi (Eng): started a routing guardrail PR draft, will tag eng-runtime for review.

luke (All-hands host): perfect. one last ask — if anyone has a customer quote that framed a win/loss, paste it in the doc (even a single sentence). helps leadership messaging. thanks all!
file_notes: All-hands follow-up: concise win/losss synthesis and immediate actions. thread contains short, pragmatic updates and owner assignments. no title per agents.md.
